search.description:
The `search` function performs a product search based on the parameters. It updates the search context and emits events consumed by containers such as `SearchResults`, `Facets`, `Pagination`, and `SortBy`.

Passing `null` as the `request` parameter clears the current search state and resets related containers.
search.events: Emits the `search/loading`, `search/result`, and `search/error` events during the search lifecycle to update containers with search state and results.

request.description: Search variables including `phrase` (search term), `pageSize` (results per page), `currentPage` (page number), `filter` (array of filter conditions), and `sort` (array of sort criteria). Pass `null` to clear the search state.
